recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7931 unless the work group wants a broader reorganization of compartment documentation beyond the original 2015 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-7931 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I clarification request from the 2015May ballot asking for clearer rules and examples for variant searches within compartments. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution was to add more explanation about criteria for compartment selection on the compartments page and to add a few more example searches.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 37bfea665763e845403dcef6d28a2903f3c501bc, whose message is '#7931 - more doco about compartments' and whose git-svn id records SVN revision 6529, matching the Jira application comment. That commit added compartment usage examples and explanatory text to the historical source/compartments.html page.
additional_context: The current R6 source has been refactored into the active CompartmentDefinition resource pages. source/fhir.ini lists compartmentdefinition as an active resource. source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-introduction.xml explains that membership is determined by listed search parameters with the compartment resource as the value, while source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-notes.xml retains concrete Patient/Condition and Patient/Communication examples, equivalent direct searches, and union semantics. source/http.html still documents variant search forms, links to Search Contexts and Compartments, and retains the Encounter/Observation example. Later applied/published compartment issues refine boundaries and computability without reversing the FHIR-7931 guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source already conveys the approved additional explanation and examples, and adding duplicate prose to source/http.html would not change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Clarified CompartmentDefinition boundaries with GraphDefinition and confirms compartment membership criteria are intentionally simpler than graph traversal.
Refined text about resources outside compartments and access-control use without changing variant-search syntax or examples.
Clarified the role of HL7-defined CompartmentDefinition instances in current core source.
Clarified that listed resources with .param elements are considered part of a compartment, reinforcing the current membership explanation.
